title: Giving Claude/ChatGPT real-time pricing data, news, economic, and deep fundamental history has really helped my stock research - looking at ENTG today
author: SnowSilent7695
selftext:
I've recently given Claude access to real-time data as well tons of data from a variety of domains (13F filings, insider trades, macro, historical fundamentals and ratios), and it has helped tremendously in terms of finding ideas and fully vetting them. Today I asked it,

"*What are the highlights from the latest 8-K releases and are there any supplementary investor relation releases that add additional color. From this cohort, who are the biggest movers, intraday wise? Has this altered their long term technical trajectory? Please provide charts and the 8-K / investor decks in a tabular format*"

Sharing a live demo of the output, which helped me find ENTG. I also sent the same question to ChatGPT with its default settings:

"*I can definitely produce this analysis, but I* ***can't do it accurately from the information I have available right now***\*.\*

*Your request requires current market-wide data that includes:*

* *Every Form 8-K filed in the latest cohort (today / last 24 hours)*
* *Intraday price performance for each filer*
* *Current technical indicators (SMA, EMA, ATR, trend changes)*
* *Associated investor presentations / IR decks*
* *Charts for the biggest movers"*

comments.author: SnowSilent7695
comments.body:
I decided to make the MCP public to let other agents use the data as they see fit to build their own investment strategies, and it works really well in Claude. Anyone is welcome to try it out (you're giving Claude read-only access to the data platform of 750M+ datapoints that I actively maintain):

Claude: Customize > Add custom connection > in remote server url paste [https://mcp.flexreportfinapi.com/mcp](https://mcp.flexreportfinapi.com/mcp)

The MCP's repo is also public and provides more details on what you can do with it: [https://github.com/cbecks1212/flexreport-mcp](https://github.com/cbecks1212/flexreport-mcp)

The overarching goal is to make financial data and research accessible to everyone.
